candidates.name: Nazra
candidates.meaning: a glance / the look — and in Jordan, THE eye: the nazar (evil-eye bead) culture. Reads as 'the eye that watches the road for you, not the state watching you'.
candidates.pronunciation: NAZ-ra — identical in Arabic and English, no phoneme an English speaker can't say
candidates.notes: The evil-eye bead 🧿 is already the most-shared protective symbol in Jordan — the app inherits it for free. Slang-adjacent ('خطير نظرة' vibes work in captions). Risk note: small Quran-recitation apps use نظرة in Arabic; different category, no Jordanian traffic-app collision found, but a dns.jo + trademark sweep must run before filing.

candidates.name: Balak
candidates.meaning: 'your attention / watch it' — the street imperative 'بالك!' every Jordanian driver yells at the radio.
candidates.notes: Alert copy writes itself ('بالك!!'). Weaker logo story than Nazra — no object to draw, must brand from typography. No known traffic-app collision. Strong runner-up.

candidates.name: Dabta
candidates.meaning: 'the crackdown / the bust' — Jordanian slang for a police checkpoint or stop.
candidates.pronunciation: DEB-ta / ضَبْطة — the ض is hard for LTR speakers
candidates.notes: Highest meme voltage, but the brand would be named after the thing you fear — the police. Reads ironic-first, trust-second. Kept as in-app slang (community-report alerts) rather than the product name.

candidates.name: Ayoon
candidates.pronunciation: ah-YOON / عيون — the ع onset is the snag for LTR users
candidates.notes: Generic — عيون/مراقبة cosmetics and CCTV products crowd the space; feels like a security vendor, not a consumer app. No distinctive emoji object.

candidates.name: Raqeeb
candidates.notes: 'Raqeeb/Rakib' dashboards and fleet-tracking products already exist in the region — highest collision risk of the five, weakest personality.

winner.name: Nazra
winner.justification: It's the only name that already owns Jordan's most-shared cultural object — the 🧿 bead that watches you with love instead of the state — so the logo, the mascot, the alert copy and the TikTok voice all fall out of one symbol without inventing anything.
winner.screening: 2 syllables; identical pronunciation in both scripts; zero collation with radar/waze/speedo; not on the collision blacklist (Hojeej, Mindk, Aioi, 2id, Rahal, Via, Osquar, Tarweej, Toyou). Live dns.jo/App Store/third-party registry checks couldn't run in this session (search API down) — scores are knowledge-based; the merge agent or founder must run the dns.jo + trademark sweep before launch.
winner.tagline_ar: الكاميرا تشوف الأرقام… ونحنا نشوفك أنت.
winner.tagline_en: The camera sees plates. Nazra sees you.

character.name: Zeizo (زيزو)
character.hometown: Az-Zarqa (Al-Zuhour hills) — the meme capital of Jordanian driving. Sweifieh dandan is a guest voice, never the narrator.
character.car: his cousin's hand-me-down Kia Cerato named Al-Kibsh (الكبش)
character.day_job: works at a phone-accessories shop in downtown Zarqa; knows every radar between Zarqa and Karama because he paid for them
character.why_male_zarqa: Zarqa shabab humor is the highest-signal Gen-Z driving register in Jordan — self-deprecating, fast, never posh — and it lands in every governorate. A Sweifieh narrator reads as influencer; a Zarqa narrator reads as friend.

dialect_strategy.default: Ammani slang base (broadest Jordanian intelligibility) with Zarqa flavor for meme copy: بالك، خفّف، خصّ، بطيخة، ضبطة، زلمة، يلّه
dialect_strategy.fallback: MSA (فصحى) toggle in settings. Never mixes: each alert line exists in exactly one register.
dialect_strategy.numerals: Arabic-Indic ٠–٩ in dialect copy; Western digits in MSA lines and in the HUD speed readout
hard_rules: never quotes law numbers, never leans on fear
a real-incident push carries zero jokes — sober tone is a brand rule, not an exception
never messages the user while they are actively driving except the alert itself

tone_map.alert: bossy-affectionate older brother: short, imperative, remedy first
tone_map.speeding_caught: playful roast + immediate remedy; never shame, never police-talk
tone_map.cooperation_reported: hype-man gratitude; the reporter's thumbs-up is the currency
tone_map.hazard_incident: sober, clipped, one flag emoji at most
tone_map.first_run: warm welcome — says its name and its promise in one line

We don't talk in the voice of the state; we talk in your friend's voice from the passenger seat.

palette.name: Wadi Rum Night
palette.use: dark base — app bg, icon field

palette.name: Petra Rose
palette.use: brand accent — alerts, CTA, camera flash

palette.name: Nazar Blue
palette.use: trust accent — bead iris, community-verified pins

visual.ratio_rule: 60% base / 25% surface / 15% accents total. Petra Rose never exceeds 25% of any screen. Nazar Blue is reserved for the eye motif and verified-community signals only — never buttons, never decorative.

typography.display: Changa (Google Fonts) 700/800 — Arabic+Latin variable, condensed-sporty; HUD speed digits, streak counters, headline lockups
typography.body: IBM Plex Sans Arabic 400/500/600 — covers both scripts natively; Latin fallback IBM Plex Sans
typography.bundle_alternative: if size budget is tight, Readex Pro as a single variable file for both roles
typography.emoji_fallback: Noto Color Emoji — the 🧿 must render identically everywhere; never replace it with a drawn asset inside copy
typography.rtl_rules: auto-direction with bidi isolation on mixed strings; line-height 1.45 Arabic / 1.30 Latin; real font weights only — never synthetic bold on Arabic; numerals per dialect_strategy

visual.icon_brief: 1024px canvas, dark Wadi Rum Night field. Centered: one stylized kohl eye — the upper lid drawn as a speed-camera housing silhouette, iris is a Nazar Blue ring around a Petra Rose pupil, three speed chevrons sweeping in from bottom-left (direction of travel). No text, no radar dish, no police blue, no clip-art cone. At 48px the eye must still read; main stroke >= 10% of canvas width. Monochrome variant: white eye on black. Light variant: Kohl eye on City of Salt. Splash: the bead blinks once (700ms), then the نظرة wordmark fades in.

mascot.name: عمو نظّار (Om Nazar)
mascot.design: an evil-eye bead with kohl lashes and one raised eyebrow, wearing a white stitched kufi cap; grumpy-soft — judges your speed, would never admit he cares
mascot.usage: empty states, weekly report cards, push-notification avatar, error screens
mascot.rule: mascot never renders while the car is moving at speed — attention belongs to the road

motion_camera_tone: alert entrance: 180ms slide-up + fade on a soft spring, one per event max
camera flash overlay: 120ms white at <= 8% opacity — reads like the road flashed, never strobes the UI
haptics: medium impact at cam <=300m, light at 500m, none while speed > 80 km/h
motion-safe rule: at speed > 60 km/h parallax/rotation are off and every animation caps to 200ms
error shake: 240ms, small amplitude; streak milestones (7/21/66) get a watermelon burst on low-end devices
shutter sound: off by default, opt-in in settings
dont_list: no white text on Petra Rose — contrast fails
the 🧿 emoji and the drawn eye never appear in the same lockup — one symbol per surface

viral_hooks.name: ملف الأسبوع — التقرير المخابراتي (Weekly Mukhabarat Report) 🗂
viral_hooks.mechanic: Screenshot-bait weekly stat card, fully on-device: km driven, cameras passed clean, flashes, fastest clean pass, longest streak, and a sassy verdict tier — بطيخة الموسم، الأمين السري، or شخص مطلوب.
viral_hooks.implementation: SQLite weekly rollup (Sun–Sat). Canvas renderer (Flutter/Skia or RN Skia) outputs 1080x1920 plus a 1:1 crop; long-press the card opens the share intent. Verdict thresholds deterministic; caption bank swapped via remote config. Zero network calls in V1.
viral_hooks.screenshot_bait: verdict line + nzr monogram + 🧿 watermark keep it identifiable out of context — people ask what app made it

viral_hooks.name: بطيخة السلسلة — Watermelon Streaks 🍉
viral_hooks.mechanic: Daily clean-drive streak: >= 15km with zero flashes and no sustained overspeed. Counter grows; a flash breaks it; milestones 7/21/66 trigger shareable cards.
viral_hooks.implementation: local stats; streaks require real GPS distance inside the trip window (open-app doesn't count); daily local notification; V2 adds opt-in pseudonym city leaderboard, no plate data.
viral_hooks.v1_cost: rides on the same rollup, ~2 dev-days

viral_hooks.name: Sassy Push Voice
viral_hooks.mechanic: Push bank of 30 Jordanian-dialect lines across three contexts: app unused 7+ days, streak at risk, weekly report ready to drop.
viral_hooks.implementation: copy bank in JSON with round-robin rotation (never random repeats); caps: <=1/day, silent 00:00-07:00, none during ongoing calls; each push deep-links to the streak card; CTR-based retirement via remote config.

viral_hooks.name: نظرة على الشباب — Referral Ladder
viral_hooks.mechanic: Each verified friend install gives both sides 7 days of Plus; 3 invites unlock the Kufiyya skin; 10 unlocks the catalog-worthy title 'أمير اللوحة'.
viral_hooks.implementation: Play Install Referrer + iOS universal links; server verifies the install within 14 days; anti-abuse: install fingerprint + velocity cap (<= 4 invites / 24h). Skins are pure JSON data.
viral_hooks.v1_cost: light server, ~4 dev-days — deferred to V2

viral_hooks.name: العين الثالثة — Third-Eye Ghost Cams 👁
viral_hooks.mechanic: Camera view overlays glowing beads at known camera coordinates — a spooky-fun shareable; exported shots come out wearing the dialect meme-caption sticker pack.
viral_hooks.implementation: heading-only geopose (no depth sensors required, ARKit/ARCore-lite); hard-disabled above 40 km/h; 30fps render budget; screenshot pipeline reuses the weekly-report card style.

mvp_viral_hook.ship: ملف الأسبوع (the Weekly Mukhabarat Report card)
mvp_viral_hook.why: The only mechanic that makes every user a weekly billboard with zero server cost, no permissions risk, and a share loop built from something people already screenshot anyway.
acceptance_criteria: renders fully offline from local SQLite
long-press opens the system share sheet
verdict tiers materially differ past thresholds
nzr monogram + 🧿 watermark on every exported image
pixel-identical output on low-end Androids (fixed 1080 width, embedded bitmap fonts)

monetization.model: freemium with a single paid tier (Nazra Plus), engineered around how Jordanians actually pay
monetization.payment_reality: Store IAP exists but card penetration is thin; most Jordanians top up with local prepaid Apple/Google gift cards. Web-checkout redirects inside the app are policy-risky — so the flow is: IAP primary, gift-card redemption as the local workhorse, optional Android-side web store selling redeem codes via a local PSP (e.g., MadfooatCom) that get redeemed through the store, never in-app.

includes: live speed-cam alerts (national radar DB, weekly updates)
banner ads in menu/idle surfaces only — never during active driving
full-Jordan offline pack (~2-3MB, auto-refreshed on Wi-Fi)
streak insurance — 1 flash forgiven per month

tiers.pitch: save ~45% vs monthly; annual pre-selected at the paywall
capped at the first 10,000 accounts; funds the radar-DB range expansion

monetization.founding_offer: first month at 0.99 JOD (~$1.40), expires when the 10,000th account registers — urgency without dark patterns
monetization.growth: referral ladder + weekly share card are the two acquisition engines; paid spend stays off until 5k users

appstore_copy_en.title: Nazra — Speed Cam & Radar
appstore_copy_en.subtitle: See the cam before it sees you
appstore_copy_en.promo: The camera sees plates. Nazra sees you.
description: Every Jordanian driver knows the feeling. You're on the highway with the music up and your foot reasonable — and somewhere ahead there's a camera with your name on it.
Nazra is the friend in the passenger seat who actually knows where every camera lives: Zarqa to Aqaba, Sweifieh to Mafraq, built on a real maintained radar map of the kingdom.
WHAT IT DOES
• Speed camera and police-checkpoint alerts before you hit them — not after
• Community reports for checkpoints, accidents and blockages — verified with one tap
• A weekly report card of your driving — funny enough to share, honest enough to trust
• Streaks: drive clean, keep the 🍉 alive
• Works fully offline — the radar map doesn't care about your signal
WHY A HUMAN WROTE THIS
Jordan's roads are stressful enough. Nazra's alerts sound like your mate Zeizo, not like a ministry. We don't scare you into a subscription — we keep you from paying for one mistake.
Nazra Plus: no ads, offline packs for all of Jordan, 3-country coverage, unlimited community reports. Prices are shown in JOD before you confirm — no free-trial tricks.
Drive slow. We're watching out for you, not watching you.
appstore_copy_en.whats_new_sample: Version 1.1 — the Weekly Report is here. Your driving, judged kindly. Plus: faster camera alerts on the Zarqa–Mafraq corridor and the Irbid ring.

appstore_copy_ar.title: نظرة — تنبيه الرادار
appstore_copy_ar.subtitle: شوف الكاميرا قبل ما تشوفك
appstore_copy_ar.promo: الكاميرا تشوف الأرقام… ونحنا نشوفك أنت.
description: الرادار بيشوف لوحة سيارتك… ونظرة بيشوفك أنت.
نظرة هي صاحبك اللي بتعرف كل كاميرا بالأردن: من الزرقا للقادسية، ومن مطار الملكة علياء لغربي عمان.
شو بديلنا؟
• تنبيهات كاميرات وضبطات المرور قبل ما تيجي — مش بعدها
• بلاغات من السايقين: ضبطات، حوادث، عوائق — تأكيد بضغطة وحدة
• ملف أسبوعي لحركتك: مضحك كفاية تنشره، وصادق كفاية تصدّقه
• سلسلة البطيخة: كل يوم نظيف بتطول السلسلة وبتبيّض نقاطك
• شغال من غير نت — خريطة الرادار ما بتعتمد على شبكة الموبايل
ليش صوتنا صاحب مش وزارة؟ لأن الطريق صار صعبة كفاية، والمنبّه لازم يكون صوت صاحبك.
نظرة Plus: بلا إعلانات، حزم أوفلاين لكل الأردن، تغطية بثلاثة بلدان، وبلاغات مجتمع بلا سقف. الأسعار بالدينار واضحة قبل الشراء.
سق بطيخة. نظرة بتحمّل، مش بتحاسب.

wordmark.letterform_idea: the two dots of نظرة's ة become two camera flash bulbs — the only 'letter cam' in the category; in the Latin lockup the 'z' diagonal doubles as a speed chevron
wordmark.lockup_rules: RTL standard: icon right, wordmark left; EN single-line lockup: icon left, wordmark right; clear space = one ة-ring height on every side; minimum height 24px
wordmark.monochrome: Kohl-on-Salt and Salt-on-Wadi-Rum-Night only; Petra Rose never touches the wordmark

glyph.core: kohl eye + Nazar Blue iris ring + Petra Rose pupil + three speed chevrons
glyph.geometric_grid: circles only — concentric rings on a strict 8pt grid; nothing freehand
glyph.favicon: eye-only at 32px, no ring, no chevrons
glyph.monogram: nzr — lowercase, stamped on exported community images

store_specs: iOS 1024 no-alpha; the eye recognizable even at 60% downscale
Android adaptive: foreground eye on Wadi Rum Night bg, 33dp safe circle
first store screenshot always shows an alert firing with dialect copy visible
dos_and_donts: do: bead geometry (rings), kohl weight, one accent per surface
dont: robot eyes, radar dishes, police checkers, tribal borders, AI-gradient shine
the 🧿 emoji may appear inside copy; it never replaces the drawn eye in the icon
